simplifications.name: floor trough (+X)
simplifications.modelled_as: one circular (r,z) section revolved about the cup axis between the spout angles
simplifications.deviation_cost: rms 0.303 / p95 0.573 mm on floor cells (includes rib-base cells)

simplifications.name: handle grip
simplifications.modelled_as: straight cone about a straight fitted axis
simplifications.deviation_cost: station radius residual rms 0.026 / max 0.075 mm (quadratic rms 0.014)

simplifications.name: funnel floor
simplifications.deviation_cost: rms 0.106 / p95 0.141 / max 0.788 mm on flat floor cells

simplifications.name: pad face
simplifications.modelled_as: one vertical-axis cone (reverse draft) above the under-chamfer
simplifications.deviation_cost: rms 0.054 / p95 0.059 / max 0.719 mm; z < -26 transitions deviate more (station fits in pad_fit.json)

simplifications.name: lug under-faces
simplifications.modelled_as: two inclined planes per lug: the main ramp and the trailing lead-out (helical ramps approximated)
simplifications.deviation_cost: ramp line rms 0.071/0.061/0.052 mm; plane vs helix < 0.06 mm over the lug width

simplifications.name: ribs
simplifications.modelled_as: U rib constant thickness (no draft); V ribs drafted, two straight crest segments each
simplifications.deviation_cost: V crest segments rms 0.09+0.10/0.10+0.08 mm; U-leg inner 5.09 vs outer 6.49 at mid-height (draft ignored)

simplifications.name: wire spring
simplifications.modelled_as: three planar arcs of round wire; the ends diving into the bore windows are not modelled
simplifications.deviation_cost: fit rms 0.12/0.32/0.44 mm; hidden wire behind the bore not modelled

simplifications.name: lug-to-wall and small edge rounds
simplifications.deviation_cost: local, < 1 mm at the lug roots (see lugs_notches.json)

CHK-COUNT.note: lugs 3, spouts 2, wire arcs 3, V ribs 2: counted as separated angular/area clusters (lugs_notches.json, spouts_screw.json, wire.json, ribs_floor.json); no rotational-order FFT count was needed because no pattern is repeated more than 3 times

CHK-CLUSTER.note: every coherent cluster in the height maps is assigned to a feature (ribs, screw heads, wire, pockets); the spout pockets are open holes in the mesh (unscanned) and are modelled as assumed geometry

CHK-FRAME.note: all angles re-measured in the frozen datum frame; none copied from intake
